items.title: Set up Vite and TypeScript
items.notes: Add a browser entry point, reproducible npm install, strict type checking, calendar tests, and a static production build. Verify the initial clock in Chrome.

items.title: Implement Harptos date arithmetic
items.notes: Support 24-hour days, twelve 30-day months, three tendays per month, five intercalary festivals, and Shieldmeet after Midsummer every fourth year. Verify Greengrass, the Nightal-to-Hammer rollover, and Midsummer in 1491 and 1492 DR.

items.title: Build the campaign clock screen
items.notes: Display the Harptos date and 24-hour clock on one DM screen. Start on 1 Tarsakh 1491 DR, Year of the Scarlet Witch. The proposed initial hour is 08:00.

items.title: Style the campaign tracker with shadcn/ui
items.notes: Use the Midnight Archive-inspired charcoal, parchment, and gold palette, with ember copper for Neverwinter and mineral green for Phandelver. Verify the clock and responsive layout on desktop and mobile.

items.title: Add date entry and time advances
items.notes: Accept valid dates and times including festival days. Keep the last valid time and explain rejected input. Add advances of 1, 2, 4, and 8 hours and 1 and 10 elapsed days. Verify that 25 Tarsakh plus 10 days lands on 4 Mirtul at the same clock time.

items.title: Restore campaign time after reload
items.notes: Save one campaign in the current browser. Restore the last valid date and time after closing and reopening the tracker. Use the campaign start defaults when no prior save is available.

items.title: Switch between Neverwinter and Phandalin
items.notes: Use Neverwinter as the proposed initial location. Keep the current clock when switching locations and restore the selected location on reload.
